deduplication_rules.rule_a_no_dataset_multiplication: Replaying or re-analyzing the frozen 270-stimulus corpus across multiple evaluation scripts does NOT constitute independent empirical replication. All 5 prior studies share the same primary data lineage.
deduplication_rules.rule_b_no_evidence_inflation: Observed phenomena (358 collapse pairs, Regime 2 temporal stream, research adapter policy distributions) are analytical facets of the same underlying dynamical simulation, not distinct empirical samples.
